criteria.text: Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $2,400,000 (3 x ($4,800,000 - $4,000,000), subject to the $10,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $3,000,000 is wrong.

Identifies the threatened $450,000 claim by Corrib Media Ltd recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 9.5 is stated as $11,250,000 but 10% of the $90,000,000 Purchase Price is $9,000,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.
Shows the earn-out arithmetic and flags the discrepancy between $2,400,000 and the Seller's $3,000,000.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
Shows proposed drafting changes as before/after (current wording vs proposed wording) with a one-line rationale.
